A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Vrot''' served as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] in the employ of [[Soergg Vosadii Bezhin|Soergg]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he took part in a [[Second skirmish in Cuipernam|skirmish]] that took place in [[Cuipernam]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]]. During the skirmish, mercenaries under the employ of Soergg attempted to stop [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]], from reaching the municipal hall where the vote for Ansion's secession was taking place. While the Jedi were hiding in a nearby building, the well-armed [[Vrot]]&mdash;who had been hiding behind two civilians&mdash;aimed his weapon at Master Unduli while she was distracted by two other assailants. However, before the Vrot could pull the trigger, [[Tooqui]], a male [[Gwurran]], jumped onto his head. The Vrot threw Tooqui off him, but before he could shoot the Gwurran, he was attacked by the [[Ansionian]]s [[Kyakhta]] and [[Bulgan]], who proceeded to beat the Vrot with the help of the Gwurran.<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Vrot appeared in the [[2002]] novel ''[[The Approaching Storm]]'', which was written by [[Alan Dean Foster]].<ref name="The Approaching Storm" />
